set.body:
Scope: modules/mvpa-spatial and ../mvpa4s optional locus/image adapters.

Deliverable: Move reusable region/searchlight measurement and result-scatter contracts; retain atlas- and ScalaFIM-threshold-specific wiring downstream. Leave surface composition for U6.

Acceptance:
- Generic adapters depend only on mvpa4s and the relevant provider APIs.
- Volume/region/searchlight measurements preserve ordering, masking, wrong-domain rejection and scatter results on JVM/JS.
- No independent domain/image wrappers or copied spatial kernels are introduced.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U4: Extract generic locus and image measurement adapters
